svg.aria-label: Saint Pierre and Miquelon real coastline and georeferenced Hero and eight Scene points
svg.title: SAINT PIERRE AND MIQUELON / MAP
svg.desc: Real shorelines: IGN ADMIN EXPRESS COG CARTO PE 2026 (French Open Licence); Ile aux Vainqueurs: WOF 85632371 Quattroshapes (CC BY 2.0). The naturally formed sandy isthmus and Grand Barachois lagoon follow sourced land geometry. Saint-Pierre is shown at a different scale in the inset.
svg.metadata: Target land: GSHHG/GSHHS full-resolution shoreline via Basemap 2.0.0 (Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith; https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/wessel/gshhg/), assigned with Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 countries ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19 (public domain) unit SPM (Saint Pierre and Miquelon); internal land boundaries follow Natural Earth. Surrounding land: the same GSHHG shoreline, drawn to the canvas edge. WGS84; local-equirectangular-fit-v1, 1200x760. Newfoundland (Canada) is context only. Saint-Pierre inset: same geometry at uniform scale.
